name: xex-monorepo
description: XeX design system: packages (@xex/tokens, @xex/tailwind-preset, @xex/ui) and the docs site.

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @xex/docs
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @xex/tokens && npm run build -w @xex/ui
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @xex/docs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @xex/tokens -w @xex/ui -w @xex/docs
